articles.title_en: The curse of television: Evidence from nutritional outcomes in rural China
You go, I stay: intrahousehold evacuation behavior upon a disaster
A machine learning approach to assessing multidimensional poverty and targeting assistance among forcibly displaced populations
articles.title_cn: 一种评估多维贫困和针对被迫流离失所人口提供援助的机器学习方法
articles.abstract_en: • Data science enables poverty targeting beyond PMT and unidimensional expenditure metrics. • Machine learning can identify refugee households most in need using flexible, multidimensional measures. • Geospatial and place-based factors are essential for accurate poverty prediction. • Traditional targeting methods may overlook food-insecure households in need of aid. • Regular updating poverty metrics and predictive models improves targeting over time. Increasing trends in forced displacement and poverty are expected to intensify in coming years. Data science approaches can be useful for governments and humanitarian organizations in designing more effective targeting mechanisms. This study applies machine learning techniques and combines geospatial data with survey data collected from Syrian refugees in Lebanon over the last four years to help develop more effective and efficient targeting strategies. Our proposed approach helps: (1) identify the households most in need of assistance based on a flexible, multidimensional poverty metric and (2) operationalize this method without resorting to impractical and expensive data collection procedures. Our findings highlight the importance of a comprehensive and versatile framework that captures other poverty dimensions along with the commonly used expenditure metric, while also allowing for regular updates to keep up with (rapidly) changing contexts over time. The analysis also points to geographical heterogeneities that are likely to impact the effectiveness of targeting strategies. The insights from this study have important implications for agencies seeking to improve targeting and increase the efficiency of shrinking humanitarian funding.
articles.abstract_cn: • 数据科学使贫困瞄准超越PMT和一维支出指标。 • 机器学习可以利用灵活的多维测量识别最需要帮助的难民家庭。 • 地理空间和基于地点的因素对于准确的贫困预测至关重要。 • 传统瞄准方法可能忽略需要援助的粮食不安全家庭。 • 定期更新贫困指标和预测模型可以随着时间的推移改进瞄准。 预计未来几年，被迫流离失所和贫困的增加趋势将加剧。数据科学方法可以帮助政府和人道主义组织设计更有效的瞄准机制。本研究应用机器学习技术，并将地理空间数据与过去四年从黎巴嫩叙利亚难民收集的调查数据相结合，以帮助制定更有效和高效的瞄准策略。我们提出的方法有助于：(1) 基于灵活的多维贫困指标识别最需要援助的家庭，以及 (2) 在不诉诸不切实际且昂贵的数据收集程序的情况下实施该方法。我们的发现强调了一个全面且多功能的框架的重要性，该框架在常用的支出指标之外还捕捉其他贫困维度，同时允许定期更新以跟上（快速）变化的环境。分析还指出了可能影响瞄准策略有效性的地理异质性。本研究的见解对寻求改进瞄准并提高不断缩减的人道主义资金效率的机构具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: How patron-client relations influence fisheries co-management: A case study of Bangladesh
Navigating the shadows: Exploring the interaction between social progress and the shadow economy
Sex ratio and fertility preferences in India: A longitudinal analysis
articles.title_cn: 印度的性别比与生育偏好：一项纵向分析
articles.abstract_en: • We conduct a longitudinal analysis of the relationship between district-level sex ratios and women’s son preference. • We find that in districts where sex ratios are skewed (missing women), women have a decreased son preference. • This decline operated via changes in decision-making power, age of marriage, dowry price and domestic violence acceptance. • The findings suggest a self-corrective process of sex ratio imbalance, operating through changes in son preference. Birth control policies and entrenched patriarchal norms have contributed to a highly imbalanced male/female ratio in India. While the impact of son preference on the sex ratio is largely studied, the consequences of a male-skewed sex ratio on women’s fertility preferences remain underexplored. Merging different longitudinal datasets (Indian Census and IHDS panel household survey), this article provides an original empirical analysis of the effect of district-level sex ratios on women’s fertility preferences and the nested pathways of this relationship. Individual and time fixed-effects regressions show that district-level surplus of men negatively affects women’s desired number of sons. The robustness of these findings is confirmed after conducting multiple checks, including controlling for endogeneity by leveraging temperature data from the India meteorological department (1952–2011). The investigation of potential pathways shows that a higher district male/female ratio may make gender norms and the marriage market more favorable to women (via an increase in decision-making power and age of marriage, and a decrease in the dowry price and domestic violence acceptance). We conclude that this self-corrective process which shapes the relationship between sex ratio and son preference in contexts of entrenched patriarchal norms, hinders gender equality.
articles.abstract_cn: • 我们对地区层面性别比与女性儿子偏好之间的关系进行了纵向分析。• 我们发现，在性别比失衡（失踪女性）的地区，女性的儿子偏好有所下降。• 这一下降通过决策权、结婚年龄、嫁妆价格和家庭暴力接受度的变化发挥作用。• 研究结果表明，性别比失衡存在一种自我纠正过程，通过儿子偏好的变化发挥作用。印度的生育控制政策和根深蒂固的父权制规范导致了高度失衡的男女比例。虽然儿子偏好对性别比的影响已被大量研究，但男性偏斜的性别比对女性生育偏好的后果仍未被充分探讨。本文合并不同的纵向数据集（印度人口普查和IHDS面板住户调查），对地区层面性别比对女性生育偏好的影响及这一关系的嵌套路径进行了原创性实证分析。个体和时间固定效应回归显示，地区层面男性过剩对女性期望的儿子数量有负面影响。在进行多项检验后，包括利用印度气象部门（1952-2011）的温度数据控制内生性，这些发现的稳健性得到确认。对潜在路径的考察表明，更高的地区男性/女性比例可能使性别规范和婚姻市场对女性更有利（通过决策权和结婚年龄的增加，以及嫁妆价格和家庭暴力接受度的下降）。我们得出结论，这一在根深蒂固的父权制规范背景下塑造性别比与儿子偏好之间关系的自我纠正过程，阻碍了性别平等。

articles.title_en: Ostromian institutions and violence: Community forestry and Nepal’s civil war
The impact of a sudden asylum seeker influx on host attitudes: Quasi-experimental evidence from South Korea
articles.title_cn: 突然涌入的寻求庇护者对东道主态度的影响：来自韩国的准实验证据
articles.abstract_en: How native residents, in response to asylum seekers’ inflows, change their attitudes and perceptions toward non-natives has recently become a topic of intense research. However, most previous studies have focused exclusively on Western countries. The present study offers the first evidence on this issue from an East Asian context, specifically investigating South Korea , which has not traditionally been a destination for forcibly displaced individuals (excluding North Korean defectors). For causal evidence, this paper exploits the sudden influx of Yemeni asylum seekers to Jeju Island in South Korea , which only impacted the island ‘locally’—due to the region’s unique visa-exemption policy and the government’s immediate restrictions on the asylum seekers’ post-arrival cross-region movement off the island. Furthermore, the geographic feature of the island eliminates spill-over concerns, providing a unique, ideal quasi-experimental setting. The difference-in-differences estimates suggest that the abrupt influx of asylum seekers decreased host residents’ multicultural acceptance and negatively affected their attitudes and perceptions toward non-natives. Notably, strong heterogeneity seems to exist, depending on hosts’ economic (e.g., education, income, employment status) and non-economic (e.g., age, multicultural education) factors. This study extends its examination to various other outcomes, such as neighborhood preference and national pride.
articles.abstract_cn: 本土居民如何应对寻求庇护者的流入而改变其对非本土居民的态度和看法，近来已成为一个激烈研究的主题。然而，大多数先前的研究仅集中于西方国家。本研究首次提供了来自东亚背景下的关于这一问题的证据，具体考察了韩国，该国传统上并非被迫流离失所者（不包括脱北者）的目的地。为了获得因果证据，本文利用了也门寻求庇护者突然涌入韩国济州岛这一事件，该事件仅‘局部’影响了该岛——由于该地区独特的免签政策以及政府对寻求庇护者抵达后跨区域离开该岛流动的立即限制。此外，该岛的地理特征消除了溢出效应担忧，提供了一个独特、理想的准实验环境。双重差分估计表明，寻求庇护者的突然涌入降低了东道主居民的多文化接受度，并对其对非本土居民的态度和看法产生了负面影响。值得注意的是，根据东道主的经济（如教育、收入、就业状况）和非经济（如年龄、多元文化教育）因素，似乎存在强烈的异质性。本研究将其考察扩展到各种其他结果，如邻里偏好和民族自豪感。

articles.title_en: Blood, education and economic Development: How the 19th century wars in Latin America Foiled its economic development
articles.title_cn: 鲜血、教育与经济发展：拉丁美洲的19世纪战争如何阻碍了其经济发展
articles.abstract_en: • The prolonged war in the 19 th century LA led to underinvestment in human capital and delayed economic development. • Regressions reveal that the high military budget share crowded out public spending on education and R&D. • Underinvestment in human capital has been a significant contributor to poor performance up to the present day. In this paper, we hypothesize that the prolonged wars in Latin America during most of the 19th century hindered human capital development and delayed economic progress well into the 20th century. Collecting novel data for the seven largest Latin American economies over the period 1820–2016, we show that the extraordinarily large share of military expenditure in total spending crowded out investment in education and R&D, which in turn had persistent effects on economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: • 拉丁美洲在19世纪旷日持久的战争导致人力资本投资不足，并延迟了经济发展。• 回归分析显示，高额军事预算占比挤出了公共教育支出和研发支出。• 人力资本投资不足一直是导致至今表现不佳的重要因素。在本文中，我们假设拉丁美洲在19世纪大部分时间里旷日持久的战争阻碍了人力资本发展，并将经济进步的延迟延续到20世纪。我们收集了七个最大拉丁美洲经济体在1820-2016期间的新数据，表明军事支出在总支出中异常高的占比挤出了教育和研发投资，进而对经济发展产生了持久影响。

articles.title_en: Smart carbon–neutral development: Embracing complexity with multi-level governance and convolution
articles.title_cn: 智慧碳中和开发：以多层次治理与卷积拥抱复杂性
articles.abstract_en: • The EU Missions framework drives transformative and systemic changes essential for achieving both mitigation and adaptation outcomes. • Thessaloniki’s Net Zero Plan uses tech, governance and management solutions across sectors, applying a systems-innovation approach and multiple levers to cut emissions. • Enhancing our understanding of spatial impacts requires continuous recalibration of governance strategies to ensure effective policy implementation. • Path-dependence in both actions and governance models poses limitations, highlighting the need for a systems perspective in smart carbon–neutral development. • Policy design should be seen as a convolution process—where actions and governance models merge—rather than as separate entities that need to be linked or combined. This paper delves into the current EU policy and strategy for advancing smart, carbon–neutral development across Europe, as outlined by the EU Missions framework. This framework aims to boost the resilience to climate change of at least 150 European regions and communities and facilitate the transformation of 100 cities into climate-neutral and smart urban centers by 2030. Our primary objective is to explore potential synergies between theoretical concepts and their practical application in realizing smart carbon–neutral development. Specifically, we examine the challenges associated with scaling processes inherent in smart carbon–neutral development alongside the transformative and systemic changes required to achieve significant levels of both mitigation and adaptation. Using the Net Zero Action Plan for Thessaloniki as a case study, we examine the efficacy of designing policies at both the operational and governance levels. We argue that a complexity-based approach is applicable in this context: as we refine our understanding of the spatial impact of interventions, our certainty regarding the necessary governance level diminishes, and vice versa. Finally, we discuss the potential for realizing the ambitious objectives of the EU Missions framework through a convolution perspective and the challenges associated with bridging the gap between theoretical concepts and practical implementation.
articles.abstract_cn: • 欧盟使命框架推动变革性和系统性变化，这对于实现减缓和适应成果至关重要。 • 塞萨洛尼基的净零计划跨部门使用技术、治理和管理解决方案，应用系统创新方法和多种杠杆来减少排放。 • 增强我们对空间影响的理解需要持续重新校准治理策略，以确保有效的政策实施。 • 行动和治理模型中的路径依赖构成限制，凸显了在智慧碳中和开发中采用系统视角的必要性。 • 政策设计应被视为一个卷积过程——其中行动和治理模型融合——而不是需要连接或组合的独立实体。 本文深入探讨了欧盟使命框架所概述的当前欧盟推进欧洲智慧、碳中和开发的政策和战略。该框架旨在提升至少 150 个欧洲地区和社区对气候变化的韧性，并促进 100 个城市在 2030 年前转变为气候中和的智慧城市中心。我们的主要目标是探索理论概念与其在实现智慧碳中和开发中的实际应用之间的潜在协同效应。具体而言，我们考察了智慧碳中和开发中固有的规模化过程所带来的挑战，以及实现显著水平的减缓和适应所需的变革性和系统性变化。以塞萨洛尼基净零行动计划为案例研究，我们考察在运营和治理层面设计政策的有效性。我们认为，基于复杂性的方法在此背景下是适用的：随着我们对干预措施空间影响的理解不断精炼，我们对必要治理层级的确定性减弱，反之亦然。最后，我们讨论了通过卷积视角实现欧盟使命框架宏伟目标的潜力，以及弥合理论概念与实际实施之间差距所面临的挑战。

articles.title_en: “Mitti se Sona [Gold from Dirt]?”: Solar India and colonial modernity in Agropastoral Rajasthan
Claiming the city: Citizenship and political connections in African neighborhoods
articles.title_cn: 索取城市：非洲社区中的公民身份与政治联系
articles.abstract_en: • Residents make claims on formal structures, non-state authorities, and political parties. • Neighborhoods rely on local political connections to access state power. • Claim-making strategies depend on neighborhood class structure. • Poor neighborhoods rely on voting blocs, concerned youth associations and political clientelism. • Wealthy neighborhoods bypass government to leverage connections with politicians. Rapid urbanization is changing the way Africans experience and engage the state in their everyday lives, creating new opportunities for urban claim-making. But it also creates the conditions for local capture. In their quest for rights and services, how do neighborhoods navigate these rapidly changing political environments? How does this vary across poor, middle-class, and wealthy neighborhoods? Based on 16 focus group discussions and 87 key informant interviews in eight neighborhoods in Lagos (Nigeria) and Accra (Ghana), we find that residents in low-income neighborhoods seek direct connections through voting blocs and the instrumental use of their concerned youth associations, while high-income neighborhoods use personal connections and leverage their residence associations to influence state power. We argue that a neighborhood’s class structure shapes the political connections that residents have to the state, thereby shaping the everyday strategies that residents use to claim citizenship.
articles.abstract_cn: • 居民对正式结构、非国家权威和政党提出诉求。• 社区依赖地方政治联系来获取国家权力。• 诉求策略取决于社区的阶级结构。• 贫困社区依赖投票集团、有关青年协会和政治庇护主义。• 富裕社区绕过政府，利用与政治家的联系。快速城市化正在改变非洲人在日常生活中体验和参与国家的方式，为城市诉求创造了新的机会。但它也为地方俘获创造了条件。在寻求权利和服务的过程中，社区如何应对这些快速变化的政治环境？这在贫困、中产阶级和富裕社区之间有何不同？基于在拉各斯（尼日利亚）和阿克拉（加纳）八个社区进行的16次焦点小组讨论和87次关键信息人访谈，我们发现低收入社区的居民通过投票集团和有关青年协会的工具性使用来寻求直接联系，而高收入社区则利用个人关系并借助其居民协会来影响国家权力。我们认为，社区的阶级结构塑造了居民与国家之间的政治联系，从而塑造了居民用来主张公民身份的日常策略。

articles.title_en: Beyond urban bias? Urban-rural inequalities and popular protest in Africa
‘This country is free, but for the few’: Informal labour, class politics, and urban order in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
articles.title_cn: “这个国家是自由的，但只属于少数人”：坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆的非正规劳动、阶级政治与城市秩序
articles.abstract_en: This article explores the relationships between regime consolidation, labour informality, and class formation in African cities. It examines how, as part of broader efforts to build political support, incumbent leaders and their parties manipulate class formation among urban informal workers.A defining feature of Africa’s rapid urbanisation is the expansion of a large tranche of low-income informal workers. We argue that, in a manner reminiscent of colonial efforts to control a then emerging urban working class, leaders adopt approaches to regulating labour informality—especially workers’ access to space and their symbolic recognition—that then influence class formation. These regulatory interventions either encourage greater unity among workers, or else help divide an incipient ‘urban mass’, introducing hierarchies between ‘respectable’ classes of small-scale ‘entrepreneurs’ and their more unruly counterparts. Having drawn these distinctions, we further theorise how and why incumbent leaders pursue one strategy or another, arguing that they regulate informal workers—and seek to influence their intra-class solidarities—in ways consistent with efforts both to consolidate a ruling coalition and to counter opposition electoral pressures.We explore this theory further through our case study—Tanzania’s commercial capital, Dar es Salaam. This involves contrasting the regulatory approaches adopted by Presidents John Pombe Magufuli (2015–2021) and Samia Suluhu Hassan (2021–), both from Tanzania’s long-time ruling party, CCM. For our empirical material, we combine focus groups, interviews, participant observation, and press reviews. Finally, while our case study involves an authoritarian regime, we use our conclusion to reflect further on commonalities and differences across regime types, democratic or authoritarian, and on the significance of class-differentiated experiences of freedom and repression in the city.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨非洲城市中政权巩固、劳动非正规性与阶级形成之间的关系。文章考察了现任领导人和其政党如何作为构建政治支持的更广泛努力的一部分，操纵城市非正规工人的阶级形成。非洲快速城市化的一个决定性特征是大量低收入非正规工人的扩张。我们认为，以一种令人联想到殖民时期控制当时新兴城市工人阶级的方式，领导人采取了对劳动非正规性进行监管的方法——特别是工人对空间的使用权及其象征性承认——进而影响阶级形成。这些监管干预要么鼓励工人之间更大的团结，要么有助于分裂一个初生的“城市大众”，在“体面的”小规模“企业家”阶级与其更不守规矩的对应群体之间引入等级。在得出这些区分之后，我们进一步理论化现任领导人为何以及如何追求一种或另一种策略，认为他们监管非正规工人——并试图影响其阶级内部团结——的方式与巩固执政联盟和应对反对派选举压力的努力相一致。我们通过案例研究——坦桑尼亚的商业首都达累斯萨拉姆——进一步探讨这一理论。这涉及对比总统约翰·蓬贝·马古富力（2015-2021）和萨米亚·苏卢胡·哈桑（2021–）所采取的监管方法，两人均来自坦桑尼亚长期执政的政党CCM。对于我们的经验材料，我们结合了焦点小组、访谈、参与观察和新闻评论。最后，虽然我们的案例研究涉及一个威权政权，但我们利用结论进一步反思民主或威权等不同政权类型之间的共性和差异，以及城市中自由与压制的阶级分化体验的重要性。

articles.title_en: Displacement Ecologies: An alternative conceptual framework for navigating how to reorient to a changing world
Cracks in the “gold standard”: The Eurocentrism of mining in development economics
Land acquisition and economic development: A decolonised view
Migrant capital: The role of internal migrants in mediating agrarian-industrial transformation in Northern India
articles.title_cn: 移民资本：内部移民在调解北印度农业-工业转型中的作用
articles.abstract_en: • Low and high-skilled migrants contribute to local communities undergoing structural transition. • Landowning and dominant communities benefit through the rental economy catering to migrants. • Services such as contracting, transport and catering for factories provide lucrative business opportunities for locals, besides retaining social dominance. • Landless locals find fewer benefits as they can neither find industrial jobs nor start businesses. • The pre-existing inequalities among locals are largely reproduced during structural transition. Rural-urban migration is a fundamental part of the structural transformation of economies. However, in labour-abundant economies such as India, where local and internal migrant labour are both available, firms prefer to hire cheaper migrant labour. What is the dynamic between the locals and migrants that emerges in this case? This paper aims to answer this question by analysing the role played by migrants in mediating the transition from the agrarian to the industrial. Using qualitative data and focussing on the case of Noida and Greater Noida in the vicinity of the Delhi National Capital Region, this paper conceptualises contributions of migrants to local communities as “migrant capital” generated by their role as (a) tenants that sustain a local rentier economy benefitting the locals; (b) consumers who invigorate the local market of service provision. These economic opportunities thrive on the presence of a large migrant population with specific needs. Existing research has examined the contributions of migrants to their native communities– however, the crucial role of migrants in sustaining the rural to urban and agrarian to industrial transformation in receiving communities is overlooked.
articles.abstract_cn: • 低技能和高技能移民为经历结构转型的当地社区做出贡献。• 土地所有者和主导社区通过服务于移民的租赁经济获益。• 为工厂提供承包、运输和餐饮等服务为当地人提供了有利可图的商业机会，同时保持了社会主导地位。• 无地当地人获益较少，因为他们既找不到工业工作也无法创业。• 当地人之间预先存在的不平等在结构转型期间在很大程度上被复制。城乡迁移是经济结构转型的基本组成部分。然而，在像印度这样劳动力充裕的经济体中，当地和内部移民劳动力都可用，企业更倾向于雇佣更便宜的移民劳动力。在这种情况下，当地人和移民之间出现了什么样的动态？本文旨在通过分析移民在调解从农业向工业转型中所扮演的角色来回答这个问题。利用定性数据并聚焦于德里国家首都辖区附近的诺伊达和大诺伊达案例，本文将移民对当地社区的贡献概念化为“移民资本”，这种资本由他们作为以下角色的作用产生：(a) 租户，维持有利于当地人的当地食利经济；(b) 消费者，激发当地服务提供市场。这些经济机会依赖于拥有特定需求的大量移民人口的存在。现有研究已经考察了移民对其原生社区的贡献——然而，移民在维持接收社区的农村到城市和农业到工业转型中的关键作用被忽视了。

articles.title_cn: 科特迪瓦的金矿开采、冲突与战后治理性
articles.abstract_en: • Little research of scholarly standards has been published on contemporary gold mining in Côte d’Ivoire. • The article shows how mining can present itself as a destabilising shock that reconfigures the local social order. • The 2014 Mining Code generates new forms of conflict related to local development, property rights, and identity politics. • These conflicts are a microcosm of post-war governmentality in Côte d'Ivoire. Over the last twenty years, there has been a new gold rush in West African countries along a new resource frontier. The article’s key question is how mining governance reform and discourses around the 2014 Mining Code in Côte d’Ivoire create socio-environmental conflicts over the local development model, property rights and identity politics. The article draws upon direct observation, semi-structured interviews, focus groups with gold panners, mine managers and local village populations, as well as a household survey. Building on the resource frontier literature, this article explains how gold mining sites in Côte d’Ivoire are spaces at the intersection between patronage economies, state territorialisation, capital accumulation and informality. The governance of gold mining can be viewed as a shock which destabilises local political, social and cultural practices and thereby leads to a reconfiguration of the local social order along this resource frontier. The analysis around three dimensions, the development model, property rights and identity politics, reveal a number of important characteristics with respect to the evolution of the local social order in Côte d’Ivoire. More broadly, these conflicts are a microcosm of post-war governmentality in Côte d’Ivoire: conflicts around the new norms and values in defining the social order and direction of the Ivorian state.
articles.abstract_cn: • 关于科特迪瓦当代金矿开采的学术标准研究发表甚少。• 本文展示了采矿如何表现为一种 destabilising 冲击，重新配置地方社会秩序。• 2014 采矿法典产生了与地方发展、产权和身份政治相关的新形式冲突。• 这些冲突是科特迪瓦战后治理性的缩影。过去二十年间，西非国家沿一条新的资源边疆出现了新的淘金热。本文的关键问题是，科特迪瓦的采矿治理改革以及围绕 2014 采矿法典的话语如何制造了关于地方发展模式、产权和身份政治的社会环境冲突。本文依据直接观察、半结构化访谈、与淘金者、矿场管理者和当地村庄人口的焦点小组讨论，以及一项家庭调查。基于资源边疆文献，本文解释了科特迪瓦的金矿开采场址如何是庇护经济、国家领土化、资本积累与非正规性交汇的空间。金矿开采的治理可被视为一种冲击，它 destabilises 地方政治、社会和文化实践，从而导致沿这条资源边疆的地方社会秩序重新配置。围绕三个维度——发展模式、产权和身份政治——的分析揭示了关于科特迪瓦地方社会秩序演变的一些重要特征。更广泛地说，这些冲突是科特迪瓦战后治理性的缩影：围绕界定社会秩序和科特迪瓦国家方向的新规范与价值观的冲突。
